desc: UTG 3-12x44 scope built on true strength platform, completely sealed and nitrogen filled, shockproof, fogproof and rainproof. Features a 30mm tube with multi emerald coated lenses; Ez-Tap illumination enhancing system with red/green dual-color mode and 36 color multi-color mode to accommodate all weather/light conditions; One click to the color/brightness setting last used memory; low profile illumination; premium zero locking and zero resetting target turrets.
